title: Topology of Numbers
abstract: This book presents the basic concepts and results in algebraic topology from the point of view of the theory of numbers. It includes an introduction to the subject, the classical theory of quadratic forms over the integers, as well as lattices, extensively studied in the last few decades.
summary: "Topology of Numbers" by Allen Hatcher is a comprehensive text that discusses the intersection of algebraic topology and number theory. Published in March 2004, the book covers foundational topics such as quadratic forms, algebraic integers, lattices, and their connections to homology and hyperbolic geometry.
